description: Police-reported alcohol vs measured BAC>=0.08 by how widely surviving drivers are tested (state-year survivor test-rate terciles, cumulative thresholds, state terciles), killed drivers alongside
population: FARS drivers with a measured BAC result and a known police alcohol field, in state-years with a survivor test rate; survivors and killed shown separately
outcome: police sensitivity / specificity / PPV against measured BAC >= 0.08 by how widely surviving drivers are tested
method: Unweighted 2x2 accuracy within state-year and state survivor test-rate terciles and cumulative thresholds; Wilson 95% CI for sensitivity (crash clustering ignored); descriptive, not a corrected sensitivity
